title: Kennametal Enhances High Performance Turning Platform - KCP25C
body_markdown:
# **Scheduled System Upgrade Notice**


Kennametal will be performing a system upgrade from **September 25, 2026, at 6:00 PM ET through September 27, 2026, at 10:30 AM ET** . During this period, the website and online services will be unavailable.


If you need assistance or would like to place an order during this time, please contact **Customer Service** or your **Kennametal Sales Representative** .


We are making these updates to improve your experience and expect services to resume by **10:30 AM ET on September 27, 2026** .


We appreciate your patience and understanding and apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
